              POWER:
             AC FEED:
                            - NOTE THAT THIS SITE IS FED 100A 120/208VAC 3PHASE POWER. SITE LOAD IS SPLIT OVER THESE 3 PHASES. ALL EQUIPMENT IS SINGLE

                            - MAIN FUSES (QTY3) 100A TYPE HRC OR FRN-R-100. - NO SPARE MAIN FUSES ON SITE AT THIS TIME

                +24V SYSTEM:
                            - VORTEX POWER BOARD W/ 2 X V100B25 RECTIFIERS
                            - NO SPARE RECTIFIER.

              PHASE B, RECT#3 PHASE C). NORMAL PHASE VOLTAGE READS ABOUT 117 VAC +- 2VAC ON THE RECTIFIERS.
                  -41A LOAD @ -48VDC

               TRANSMISSION:
               MLTN11 FACING QUADRA TX: 11.225GHZ, RX 10.735GHZ
                            - 56 POSITION DSX, PLENTLY OF UN-USED POSITIONS
                  -TLAN: VQ (TRIB#15)

             NOTE THAT MLTN>QUADRA HAS ALLSTREAM TRAFFIC ON TRIBS 11,12 AND 13 (SEE BELOW), CONNECTED TO WB/2 AT VQ, TO NANAIMO,
                 VIA BOWEN TO V1. REFER TO WO# X140-524 FOR FLR/CLR.
                **NOTE THE ABOVE ALLSTREAM CCTS 1 2 AND 3 (MLTN TRIB 11 12 AND 13) ARE NOW DECOMMISSIONED

               MERRITT II, W1839, VCCM

             FROM VANCOUVER:
                            - TRAVEL EAST ON HWY 1 TO HWY 5 (HOPE).
                            - TRAVEL NORTH ON HWY 5 TO MERRITT CITY CENTER (EXIT 286).
                            - EXIT WEST (OVER HWY 5) ONTO HWY 8 (WEST) (TRANSTIONS INTO NICOLA AVE TO VOGHT ST.
                            - TURN LEFT (SOUTH) ONTO VOGHT ST.
                            - CROSS OVER THE COLDWATER RIVER BRIDGE AND THE ROAD CURVES RIGHT AND TRANSTIONS INTO LINDLEY CREEK RD.
                            - TURN LEFT (SOUTH) ONTO MIDDAY VALLEY RD.
                            - RESET ODOMETER TO ZERO.
                            - FOLLOW MIDDAY VALLEY RD FOR 0.7KM THE PAVED ROAD BECOMES A GRAVEL ROAD.
                            - AT 1.9 KM YOU WILL SEE THE BASE OF THE POWERLINE THE SITE USES.
                            - CONTINUE AHEAD WITHOUT TURNING
                            - IF YOU WANT TO GO TO THE TOP OF THE EXISTING POWERLINE, TURN RIGHT AT 3.8KM AND THE ROAD WILL LEAD YOU TO A SELF
              CONTAINED SHELTER WHERE THE POWERLINE ENDS
                            - IF YOU ARE GOING TO THE TOWER SITE, CONTINUE ON THE MAIN ROAD AND MAKE A RIGHT AT 4.7 KM (THERE IS FENCE ON YOUR LEFT)
                            - FOLLOW THE ROAD AND AT 5.1 KM STAY RIGHT AT THE FORK
                            - AT 5.2 KM STAY RIGHT AT FORK
                            - AT 5.9 KM STAY RIGHT
                            - AT 6.0 KM A DIRT TRAIL LEADS RIGHT
                            - FOLLOW THE DIRT TRAIL WHICH IS VEHICLE ACCESSIBLE
                            - AT 6.4 KM TURN RIGHT
                            - AT 6.6 KM YOU ARRIVE AT A VERY STEEP HILL , YOU WILL SEE THE TOWER ON YOUR LEFT
                            - NOW RETURNING FROM THE SITE MAY BE CONFUSING
                            - FOLLOW THESE DIRECTIONS FOR THE ROUTE BACK:
                            - SET ODOMETER TO ZERO
                            - FOLLOW ROAD AND AT .2KM TURN LEFT
                            - AT .6KM FOLLOW ROAD STRAIGHT AHEAD WHICH JOINS THE MORE TRAVELLED ROAD
                            - AT 1.2 KM STAY RIGHT AT FORK
                            - AT 1.9KM TURN LEFT AND FOLLOW ROAD BACK INTO TOWN

               NOTES:
                            - TIE SITE IS IRON MOUNTAIN (VCCL)
                            - TRANSMISSION VIA ERICSSON MINI-LINK 18-8T
                            - THIS SITE IS AN OMNI, MACRO 2106 850MHZ AND 1.9MHZ GSM SITE
                            - CONTACT HIGHLAND POWER IN KAMLOOPS FOR REPAIRS TO THE POWERLINE (250-374-7446)

                            - AT 0.4 KMS STAY RIGHT (SIGN CP 16).
                            - AT 1.0 KM, CONTINUE STRAIGHT ON MAIN ROAD SWEEPING TO THE RIGHT.
                            - AT 2.0 KMS STAY LEFT AND CONTINUE UP THE HILL.
                            - AT 2.6 KMS STAY LEFT.
                            - AT 3.5 KM, STAY RIGHT ON MAIN ROAD.
